name: WISE Finance S.A.
summary: WISE Finance S.A. provides financial solutions in Poland. The company finances working capital, capital expenditures, mergers and acquisitions, and management buyouts through solutions, including debt financing, convertible debts, equity investments, mezzanine financing, and financial and strategic advisory solutions. It also focuses on car fleet management, such as short- and long-term vehicle rental, leasing, and vehicle fleet management solutions. The company serves deep sector knowledge, real estate, energy and renewable energy, transport and logistics, manufacturing, fitness and wellness, telecommunications, and new technologies industries. The company was formerly known as Noble Financials S.A. and changed its name to WISE Finance S.A. in March 2023. WISE Finance S.A. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
